title: Customize Multi-modal RAI Guardrails with Precedent-based predictions
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hateful symbols and content promoting intolerance or discrimination against religious beliefs, as part of a broader 'Hate' policy.
findings: The paper demonstrates that its proposed critique-revise mechanism can improve a model's ability to identify content promoting intolerance or discrimination against religious beliefs. By refining its own descriptions, the model can correctly identify overlooked symbols (e.g., a 'no religion' sign alongside a cross and Star of David) and understand their implications for potential hate speech.
